about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A journey built with dedication
about.description:
WHO IS MARCOS?
I'm a professional surrounded by digital transformation. After years working as an IT Manager, where I ensured complex infrastructures ran flawlessly, I decided to dive into code.
My background isn't purely technical; it's strategic. I bring the discipline of hardware maintenance, team leadership, and process vision into software development.
Currently, my focus is Web Development, aiming to build applications that not only run but solve real problems efficiently and cleanly.

timeline.title: IT Manager
timeline.description: Direct involvement in corporate IT strategic management. Leadership of high-performance technical teams, focused on critical deliveries and challenging deadlines, always preserving agility and quality. Responsible for complex project management, as well as developing and analyzing dashboards to track key performance indicators (KPIs).

timeline.title: IT Supervisor
timeline.description: Leading teams and managing infrastructure projects. Responsible for the continuous training and development of new employees, as well as orchestrating the logistical planning for IT equipment deliveries.

timeline.title: Systems Analysis Degree
